items.title: 过去完成时的“过去的过去”参照
items.brief: 先有过去锚点，才有 had done

concept.summary: 过去完成时由 had + 过去分词构成，它必须依附于一个过去的时间参照点，表示动作发生在那个参照点之前，也就是过去的过去。判断方法是先找句中的过去锚点（另一个过去动作或过去时间），再看谁更早。句中只有一个过去动作、没有更早的参照对象时，用一般过去时即可，滥用 had done 是这一知识点最常见的错误。

sections.p: 现在完成时以现在为参照，过去完成时把参照点整体后移到一个过去时刻。参照点之前的动作用 had done，参照点本身用一般过去时，当下叙述仍回到现在。
bullets: 过去完成 ← 过去参照点 ← 现在
When I arrived, the train had left.（left 早于 arrived）
By the end of last term, we had learned 1,500 words.（参照点是上学期末）

sections.p: 过去锚点可以是一个过去时间状语、一个过去时的从句谓语，也可以由上下文提供。没有显性锚点时，需要前文已经确立了过去的叙述时间。
bullets: 时间状语：by then / by the end of last year / before 1990
从句谓语：When I got there, ... / He said that ...
上下文：前句已交代过去时间，后句用 had done 交代更早的事

sections.p: 一是只有一个过去动作，没有更早的比较对象；二是两个动作按顺序发生、时间先后已由连词表明。这两种情况用一般过去时更自然，加上 had done 反而让时间关系悬空。
bullets: × I had seen him yesterday. → √ I saw him yesterday.
√ He cleaned the room and then went out.（顺序清楚，无需 had done）
√ After he had finished the work, he went home.（强调完成，可用 had done）

examples.en: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 我到车站时，火车已经开走了。
examples.note: arrived 是过去锚点，left 更早，用 had left。

examples.en: By the end of last term, we had learned 1,500 words.
examples.zh: 到上学期末，我们已经学了一千五百个单词。
examples.note: by the end of last term 是过去锚点，学习发生在此之前。

examples.en: He told me he had never been abroad.
examples.zh: 他告诉我他从未出过国。
examples.note: 宾语从句的 told 是过去锚点，更早的经历用 had been。

examples.en: I had seen him yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天见过他。
examples.note: yesterday 只是单一过去时间，没有更早的参照点，应改为 I saw him yesterday.

examples.en: When I arrived at the station, the train already left.
examples.zh: 我到车站时，火车已经开走了。
examples.note: left 早于 arrived，须用过去完成时 had already left。

examples.en: She had finished her homework before her mother came home.
examples.zh: 妈妈回家前她就做完了作业。
examples.note: before 从句的 came 是锚点，完成作业更早。

examples.en: The film had already begun when we got to the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们到电影院时电影已经开演了。
examples.note: got 是锚点，begun 更早，两个过去动作层次分明。

pitfalls.wrong: I had seen the film last week.
pitfalls.right: I saw the film last week.
pitfalls.why: last week 只是单一过去时间，句中不存在更早的参照动作，过去完成时失去比较对象。

pitfalls.wrong: When I got to the cinema, the film has begun.
pitfalls.right: When I got to the cinema, the film had begun.
pitfalls.why: 参照点 got 是过去时，比它更早的动作必须用 had done，不能跨到现在的 has begun。

pitfalls.wrong: After he had finished the work, he had gone home.
pitfalls.right: After he had finished the work, he went home.
pitfalls.why: 两个动作一先一后，只有较早的那个用过去完成时，较晚的动作用一般过去时。

contrast.diff: 一般过去时只需要一个过去时间点；过去完成时必须再有一个更晚的过去参照点，否则没有过去的过去可依。

concept.mnemonic: 两个过去排先后，先发生用 had done；只有一个过去点，老老实实用过去式。

core: 构成：had + 过去分词，所有人称同形
必须有过去锚点：过去时间状语、过去时从句或上下文
先发生的动作用 had done，锚点本身用一般过去时
只有一个过去动作时不要用 had done
常见锚点：by then / by the end of last year / when I got there
review.trigger: 句中已有过去时谓语 → 问还有没有更早的动作 → 有就把更早的写成 had done

quickCheck.q: “我到车站时火车已经开走了”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: When I got to the station, the train had already left.

quickCheck.q: I had seen him yesterday 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 只有一个过去时间点，没有更早的参照，应改为 I saw him yesterday.

quickCheck.q: 过去完成时的构成是什么？

drills.stem: By the time the fire brigade arrived, the fire ___ most of the warehouse.
drills.explain: by the time 从句的 arrived 是过去锚点，烧毁发生在此之前，用 had 加过去分词。
drills.trap: destroyed 与 arrived 处于同一时间层，无法体现先烧毁、后到达的先后关系。

drills.stem: When I got to the airport, I found that I ___ (leave) my passport at home.
drills.hint: found 是过去锚点，护照落在家里更早。
drills.explain: 宾语从句的 found 确立了过去参照点，更早发生的忘带护照用过去完成时 had left。

drills.stem: When I reached the top of the hill, the sun has risen.
drills.answer: When I reached the top of the hill, the sun had risen.
accept: When I reached the top of the hill, the sun had risen.
drills.explain: reached 是过去锚点，太阳升起更早，须用过去完成时 had risen；has risen 会把动作拉到现在，破坏时间层次。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She had never seen the sea before that trip.
drills.explain: that trip 是过去锚点，never seen 表示在此之前的经历，用过去完成时；never 放在 had 与过去分词之间。

drills.stem: 等我赶到车站时，火车已经开走了。
drills.answer: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
drills.explain: got 是过去锚点，开走更早，用过去完成时；already 放在 had 与过去分词之间。

drills.stem: By the end of last year, he ___ (write) three novels.
drills.hint: by the end of last year 是过去锚点。
drills.explain: by the end of 加过去时间表示到那时为止，动作在此之前完成，用过去完成时 had written。

items.title: 过去完成时的常见触发结构
items.brief: 看到固定框架就直接写 had done

concept.summary: 有五类结构一旦出现就基本锁定过去完成时：by the time 加过去时从句、It was the first/second time that、hardly 或 scarcely 加 when 与 no sooner 加 than、before 与 after 引导的先后关系、以及宾语从句中的时态呼应。这些结构的共同点是都提供了一个明确的过去参照点，过去完成时负责填充参照点之前的动作。no sooner 与 hardly 置于句首时还要把 had 提到主语之前，构成部分倒装。

sections.h: by the time 与 by 加过去时间
sections.p: by the time 从句用一般过去时，主句用过去完成时，表示到那个过去时刻为止已经完成。by 加过去时间点同理，常与表示完成、积累的动词连用。
bullets: By the time we got to the hall, the lecture had begun.
By the end of 2020, the company had opened 40 stores.
从句用过去时、主句用 had done，顺序不能颠倒

sections.h: It was the first time that
sections.p: 主句是 It was the first/second/last time that 时，从句用过去完成时；主句若改为 It is the first time that，从句则用现在完成时。这条对应关系是语法填空的高频考点。
bullets: It was the first time that she had flown alone.
It is the first time that she has flown alone.
It was the third time that he had visited the museum.

sections.h: hardly when 与 no sooner than 的倒装
sections.p: 这两个结构表示刚一就，主句用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时。hardly 与 no sooner 置于句首时，主句必须部分倒装，把 had 提到主语之前。
bullets: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had he arrived than the meeting began.
× No sooner he had arrived than ... → √ No sooner had he arrived than ...

sections.h: 宾语从句与未实现的打算
sections.p: 主句是过去的 said, told, thought, knew 时，从句中更早的动作要用过去完成时，这是时态呼应的要求。had hoped、had expected、had intended to do 则表示本来打算却没做成。
bullets: He said he had finished the work the day before.
I had hoped to see you at the party, but you didn't come.
She had intended to call, but her phone died.

examples.en: It was the first time that she had flown alone.
examples.zh: 那是她第一次独自坐飞机。
examples.note: 主句 was 决定从句用过去完成时。

examples.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我刚坐下电话就响了。
examples.note: hardly 置句首引起部分倒装，主句用 had done。

examples.en: By the time we got to the hall, the lecture had begun.
examples.zh: 我们到礼堂时讲座已经开始了。
examples.note: by the time 从句为过去时，主句用过去完成时。

examples.en: It was the first time that she has flown alone.
examples.zh: 那是她第一次独自坐飞机。
examples.note: 主句是 was，从句须用 had flown，不能用现在完成时。

examples.en: No sooner he had arrived than the meeting began.
examples.zh: 他刚到会议就开始了。
examples.note: no sooner 置句首必须倒装，应改为 No sooner had he arrived than ...

examples.en: He said he had finished the work the day before.
examples.zh: 他说他前一天就完成了工作。
examples.note: 宾语从句中更早的动作须用 had done，符合时态呼应。

examples.en: I had hoped to see you at the party, but you didn't come.
examples.zh: 我本希望在聚会上见到你，可你没来。
examples.note: had hoped 表示本来希望却没实现。

pitfalls.wrong: It was the third time that he has visited the museum.
pitfalls.right: It was the third time that he had visited the museum.
pitfalls.why: 主句 was 把参照点定在过去，从句中已经去过须用过去完成时，has visited 会跳到现在。

pitfalls.wrong: No sooner he had got home than it started to rain.
pitfalls.right: No sooner had he got home than it started to rain.
pitfalls.why: no sooner 置于句首时主句要部分倒装，把 had 提到主语之前。

pitfalls.wrong: By the time the police arrived, the thieves ran away.
pitfalls.right: By the time the police arrived, the thieves had run away.
pitfalls.why: by the time 从句的 arrived 是锚点，逃跑更早，须用过去完成时。

contrast.withTitle: 过去完成时的“过去的过去”参照
contrast.diff: 参照点讲原理，必须先有过去锚点；本点给可套用的固定框架，看到 by the time、It was the first time、hardly when 就直接写 had done。

concept.mnemonic: by the time、the first time、hardly when，三处见到写 had done；no sooner 要倒装。

core: by the time 加过去时从句 → 主句 had done
It was the first time that 加 had done；It is the first time that 加 have done
Hardly had ... when / No sooner had ... than，主句倒装且用 had done
宾语从句主句为过去时，更早动作用 had done
had hoped / had intended to do 表示本来打算却没实现
review.trigger: 看到 by the time、the first time、hardly 或 no sooner → 立刻检查主句是否已用 had done 并倒装

quickCheck.q: It was the second time that he ___ (visit) the city. 填什么？
No sooner ___ he arrived than it began to rain. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: had，no sooner 置句首要倒装。

quickCheck.q: had hoped to do 表示什么？

drills.stem: It was the second time that the team ___ the championship.
drills.explain: 主句是 It was，参照点在过去，从句表示在此之前已经赢过，须用过去完成时。
drills.trap: has won 把参照点拉到现在，与主句的 was 冲突，破坏了时态呼应。

drills.stem: Hardly ___ he arrived home when the storm broke.
drills.hint: hardly 置于句首，主句要部分倒装。
drills.explain: hardly when 结构表示刚一就，主句用过去完成时并部分倒装，had 提到主语 he 之前。

drills.stem: No sooner he had left the office than the printer caught fire.
drills.answer: No sooner had he left the office than the printer caught fire.
accept: No sooner had he left the office than the printer caught fire.
drills.explain: no sooner 置于句首时主句必须部分倒装，把助动词 had 提到主语之前，构成 No sooner had he left。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It was the first time that I had seen such a sunset.
drills.explain: It was the first time that 是从句用过去完成时的固定框架，had seen 表示在此之前从未见过。

drills.stem: 到去年年底，我们已经完成了三个项目。
drills.answer: By the end of last year, we had completed three projects.
require: by the end of last year
drills.explain: by the end of 加过去时间表示到那时为止已完成，主句用过去完成时 had completed。

drills.stem: He said that he ___ the film twice, so he didn't want to see it again.
drills.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句中已经看过两遍发生在更早，须用过去完成时，符合时态呼应。
drills.trap: has seen 是现在完成时，与主句的过去时 said 不在同一时间层，破坏呼应。

items.title: 过去完成时与一般过去时的顺序辨析
items.brief: 先发生的降为 had done，后发生的留过去式

concept.summary: 两个过去动作并存时，时态由先后顺序决定：较早的用 had done，较晚的、作为参照点的用一般过去时。句子出现的顺序不等于时间顺序，The train had left when we arrived 与 We arrived after the train had left 讲的是同一件事。常见错误是把两个动作都写成 had done，或把 had done 用在较晚的动作上。

sections.p: 第一步找出两个过去动作，第二步比较谁先发生，第三步把先发生的降级为 had done。顺序连词 before 与 after 已经表明先后时，两个一般过去时也可以；若要强调完成，仍可用 had done。
bullets: 先发生：had done；后发生（锚点）：一般过去时
When we arrived, the concert had begun.（先开始，后到达）
We arrived after the concert had begun.（同一事实，语序不同）

sections.p: 一是把整段叙述都套上 had done，造成没有参照点的过去完成时；二是把 had done 放在较晚发生的动作上，使时间关系颠倒。
bullets: × She had woken up and had made breakfast. → √ She woke up and made breakfast.
× The train had left when we had arrived. → √ The train had left when we arrived.
连续动作按顺序叙述时，一般过去时足够

sections.h: when 与 before after 的分工
sections.p: when 只表明两个动作在时间上相邻，先后要靠时态体现；before 与 after 已由词义表明先后，时态可以简化。理解这一点，才能在改错题中判断 had done 是否必要。
bullets: When I got home, my wife had cooked dinner.（饭先做好）
After she finished the report, she went home.（先后已由 after 表明）
Before he came, we had cleaned the room.（强调完成，用 had done）

examples.en: The film had started when we got to the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们到电影院时电影已经开演了。
examples.note: started 早于 got，用过去完成时；got 是锚点。

examples.en: We got to the cinema after the film had started.
examples.zh: 电影开演之后我们才到电影院。
examples.note: 同一事实换语序，after 表明先后，had started 仍表更早。

examples.en: He cleaned the room and then went out.
examples.zh: 他打扫完房间就出去了。
examples.note: 连续动作用一般过去时，顺序由 and then 表明。

examples.en: The train had left when we had arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时火车已经开走了。
examples.note: 到达是较晚的动作，是参照点，应用一般过去时 arrived。

examples.en: She had woken up and had made breakfast.
examples.zh: 她起床做了早饭。
examples.note: 两个连续动作不需要都用过去完成时，应改为 woke up and made breakfast.

examples.en: When we arrived, the concert had already begun.
examples.zh: 我们到达时音乐会已经开始了。
examples.note: arrived 是锚点，begun 更早。

examples.en: By the time he was twenty, he had written two novels.
examples.zh: 到二十岁时他已经写了两部小说。
examples.note: was twenty 是过去锚点，写作更早完成。

pitfalls.wrong: When we got to the theatre, the play has begun.
pitfalls.right: When we got to the theatre, the play had begun.
pitfalls.why: got 是过去锚点，开演更早，须用过去完成时；has begun 会把动作拉到现在。

pitfalls.wrong: She had woken up and had made breakfast.
pitfalls.right: She woke up and made breakfast.
pitfalls.why: 按时间顺序叙述的一连串动作用一般过去时，过去完成时只留给更早于锚点的那一个动作。

pitfalls.wrong: We had arrived at the station after the train had left.
pitfalls.right: We arrived at the station after the train had left.
pitfalls.why: 到达是较晚的动作，充当参照点，必须用一般过去时，否则两个动作都悬空。

contrast.withTitle: 过去完成时的常见触发结构
contrast.diff: 触发结构靠信号词套句式；顺序辨析靠比较两个过去动作的先后，决定哪一个降级为 had done。

concept.mnemonic: 先发生 had done，后发生过去式；句子顺序不算数，时间先后才算数。

core: 两个过去动作：先发生的 had done，后发生的用一般过去时
句子语序不等于时间顺序，先比较先后再定时态
连续动作按顺序叙述用一般过去时即可
before/after 已表明先后，时态可简化；when 需要时态体现先后
不能两个动作都用 had done，也不能把 had done 放在较晚的动作上
review.trigger: 一句里出现两个过去动作 → 比较先后 → 只给较早的那个加 had

quickCheck.q: “我到的时候电影已经开演了”怎么说？
quickCheck.a: The film had started when I arrived.

quickCheck.q: She had woken up and had made breakfast 有什么问题？
quickCheck.a: 连续动作用一般过去时即可：She woke up and made breakfast.

quickCheck.q: after 从句已表明先后，主句还能用 had done 吗？
quickCheck.a: 可以，但通常用一般过去时更简洁。

drills.stem: The meeting ___ when I walked into the room, so I said nothing.
drills.explain: walked 是过去锚点，会议开始更早，用过去完成时；后半句因此我没说话也说明会议已处于进行中。
drills.trap: began 会理解为“我进门时会议才开始”，与因此我没说话的语境不符。

drills.stem: By the time the guests arrived, she ___ (prepare) a whole table of dishes.
drills.hint: by the time 从句是过去时，主句表示更早完成的动作。
drills.explain: arrived 是过去锚点，准备饭菜在此之前完成，用过去完成时 had prepared。

drills.stem: The train had left when we had arrived at the platform.
drills.answer: The train had left when we arrived at the platform.
accept: The train had left when we arrived at the platform.
drills.explain: 到达是较晚的动作，充当参照点，必须用一般过去时 arrived；只有更早的离开用过去完成时。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The film had already started when we got there.
drills.explain: started 早于 got，用过去完成时；already 放在 had 与过去分词之间，when 从句用一般过去时作锚点。

drills.stem: 我到家的时候，妻子已经做好了晚饭。
drills.answer: When I got home, my wife had already cooked dinner.
drills.explain: got home 是过去锚点，做饭更早完成，用过去完成时；already 位于 had 与过去分词之间。

drills.stem: She ___ up, ___ her teeth and left for work.
drills.explain: 起床、刷牙、出门是按时间顺序发生的一连串动作，都用一般过去时，先后由语序和并列结构表明。
drills.trap: had woken; had brushed 把连续动作全部降级为过去的过去，句中没有任何更早的参照点支撑。
